title: Embedded feature tiered HC and cost stormcase - Nov 2025
content:
Purpose:
This sheet models headcount (HC) and unit economics for a new embedded-features product tier ("embedded-lite", "embedded-pro", "embedded-prem") and runs a 'cost stormcase' sensitivity where GPU unit-costs and usage increase unexpectedly and price elasticity pushes on demand. Goal is to propose a concrete HC phasing and pricing bands to preserve margin > 35% under base and mild-stormcase, and identify triggers for emergency measures if a deep stormcase occurs.

High-level assumptions (shared across scenarios):
- Time horizon: 6 quarters (Q4 2025 -> Q1 2027).
- Avg token usage per active seat per month: embedded-lite 0.6M, pro 2.5M, prem 12M.
- Hosted API margin target before overhead: >= 45% target; company-level margin target >= 35%.
- GPU unit hourly cost baseline (effective after amort/ops): $0.85 / GPU-hour (baseline). Stormcase high: $1.45 / GPU-hour.
- Effective inference cost per 1M tokens (baseline): $6.20 for lite/pro blend; stormcase: $10.80.
- Average fully-loaded FE/Eng/ML/Infra FTE cost (all-in) = $220k/year (~$18.3k/month). Eng/ML ramp time 8-12 weeks for productivity.
- Sales and CS CAC & ramp assumptions baked in at per-seat revenue models below.

Demand elasticity experiments (pricing sensitivity):
We run simplified price elasticity analysis: assume baseline conversion at listed price; elasticity coefficients estimated from field funnel A/Bs: lite -0.9, pro -1.1, prem -0.6 (percent demand change per 1% price change).
CSV columns: tier,price-change-percent,demand-change-percent,revenue-change-percent (approx)
embedded-lite,-10,9, -1.4
embedded-lite,+10,-9, +6.1
embedded-pro,-10,11, -0.8
embedded-pro,+15,-16.5, -2.9
embedded-prem,-10,6, -4.8
embedded-prem,+10,-6, +3.4

Stormcase sensitivity (two cost-shock vectors):
- Mild stormcase: GPU cost +30%, misc ops +10%, inference cost per 1M tokens +$2.0.
- Severe stormcase: GPU cost +70%, misc ops +30%, inference cost per 1M tokens +$4.6.

Projected margin impacts (quarterly average) under baseline vs mild vs severe:
CSV columns: scenario,blended-revenue-per-token,blended-cost-per-token,gross-margin
baseline,$0.00042,$0.00022,~47%
mild-storm,$0.00042,$0.00028,~33%
severe-storm,$0.00042,$0.00036,~14%

Runway and mitigation triggers: 
- If gross margin < 30% for two consecutive quarters -> immediate hiring freeze (except critical infra) + pause external consulting + accelerated quantization rollout (target Q within 6 weeks).
- If gross margin < 20% -> temporary price uplift on new customers (targeted by tier) + restrict burst capacity (burst access gated) + explore short-term reserved capacity trading.
- If gross margin < 10% -> emergency exec review; consider temporary sales incentives pullback; customer grandfathering of older price bands for 90 days.

Sensitivity table: price change band vs HC reduction needed to keep company margin >= 35% under mild-storm (approx):
CSV columns: price-change-percent,required-hc-reduction-percent,notes
+0,0,baseline hires hold
-5,4,use hiring freeze for non-critical roles
-10,9,accelerate open req cancellations & contractor pauses
-20,18,consider selective role layoffs in non-customer-facing teams

Operational recommendations (prioritized):
1) Immediate (0-6w): freeze non-essential reqs, accelerate quantization experiments on embedded-lite/pro to reduce per-token cost by ~20% median. Assign 2 applied-ml sprints and 1 infra contractor.
2) Near term (6w-12w): Implement tiered pricing experiments A/B for pro (-5% price / +10% acquisition) and prem (+5% price / monitor churn) and measure LTV change over 90d.
3) Medium (Q1-Q2 2026): Invest in dedicated capacity contracts for top 10 prem customers to reduce burst cost; negotiate GPU reserved blocks (12-24 month) to smooth price shock.
4) Contingency: Build 'stormcase playbook' runbook in Ops with explicit rollback steps, table of affected SKUs, and CS playbook for customer communication.

Open questions & risks: 
- Elasticity estimates are still noisy (n=3 field patches and early funnel tests). Need larger A/B samples before committing price increases to prem.
- Quantization QPS impact on latency could affect SLA for embedded-prem; must validate with canary.
- Legal implications of rapid price changes for committed enterprise contracts. Work with Legal to identify clause paths.

Ask & next steps: 
- Approval to hire the engineering + applied-ml additions in skeleton above on a conditional ramp (hiring freeze triggers built into reqs).
- $250k reserved budget to fund accelerated quantization and a 12-week infra contractor to implement codec changes + perf testing.
- Run the tiered pricing A/Bs for 90 days, with measurement plan to report back to Finance & Product in 10 weeks (metrics: new MRR, churn delta, tokens/mo per seat).

Appendix (quick calculations):
- Example blended revenue per token: (weighted by seats & avg tokens) -> ~$0.00042 / token.
- Breakeven cost per token to keep margin >= 35%: ~ $0.000273 / token.
- Under mild storm (cost $0.00028) we are slightly below 35% target and need marginal cost control or ~5-10% price lift on growth channels.
